   - Pinhole Camera Geometry & Projection:
     - Image size: $512 \times 512$, horizontal and vertical FOV = $90^\circ$.

       Lateral camera offset:
       $$X_c = \frac{x_{pix} - c_x}{f} \cdot d = \frac{x_{pix} - 255.5}{256} \cdot d$$
   - Forward / Parallax Triangulation:
     - Baseline translation $\Delta Y$ allows triangulation from bounding box expansion: $\frac{w_2}{w_1} = \frac{d_1}{d_1 - \Delta Y}$.
     - Lateral translation $\Delta X$ shifts apparent image position by $\Delta x_{pix} = \frac{f \cdot \Delta X}{d}$.
